FastLmmC.exe contains, besides FaST-LMM itself (Apache License 2.0, LICENSE.TXT):

- Intel oneMKL 2026.2.1, statically linked (Intel Simplified Software License;
  Intel-oneMKL-LICENSE.txt and Intel-oneMKL-third-party-programs.txt)
- zlib 1.3.1, statically linked (zlib-LICENSE.txt)
- The Microsoft Visual C++ static runtime (Visual Studio 2022)

libiomp5md.dll is the Intel OpenMP runtime 2026.2.0 (Intel End User License Agreement for
Developer Tools; Intel-OpenMP-LICENSE.txt). Keep it in the same folder as FastLmmC.exe.
